items.name: Error
items.summary: Represents an error that can occur when parsing a gitignore file.

methods.name: depth
methods.summary: Returns a depth associated with recursively walking a directory (if this error was generated from a recursive directory iterator).

methods.name: into_io_error
methods.summary: Similar to [`io_error`] except consumes self to convert to the original [`std::io::Error`] if one exists.

methods.name: io_error
methods.summary: Inspect the original [`std::io::Error`] if there is one.

methods.name: is_io
methods.summary: Returns true if this error is exclusively an I/O error.

methods.name: is_partial
methods.summary: Returns true if this is a partial error.

items.name: Match
items.summary: The result of a glob match.

methods.name: inner
methods.summary: Return the value inside this match if it exists.

methods.name: invert
methods.summary: Inverts the match so that `Ignore` becomes `Whitelist` and `Whitelist` becomes `Ignore`. A non-match remains the same.

methods.name: is_ignore
methods.summary: Returns true if the match result implies the path should be ignored.

methods.name: is_none
methods.summary: Returns true if the match result didn't match any globs.

methods.name: is_whitelist
methods.summary: Returns true if the match result implies the path should be whitelisted.

methods.name: map
methods.signature: fn map<U, F: FnOnce(T) -> U>(self, f: F) -> Match<U>
methods.summary: Apply the given function to the value inside this match.

methods.name: or
methods.summary: Return the match if it is not none. Otherwise, return other.
